name: @laststance/electron-mcp-server

tools.name: get_electron_window_info
tools.description: Get information about running Electron applications and their windows. Automatically detects any Electron app with remote debugging enabled (port 9222).

tools.name: list_electron_windows
tools.description: List all available Electron window targets across all detected applications. Returns window IDs, titles, URLs, and ports. Use the returned IDs with any electron_* tool's targetId parameter to target specific windows.

includeDevTools.description: Include DevTools windows in the list (default: false)

tools.name: electron_take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of any running Electron application window. Returns base64 image data for AI analysis. No files created unless outputPath is specified. Pass `targetId` (from list_electron_windows) for unambiguous targeting when multiple Electron apps run on different debugging ports — `targetId` takes precedence over `windowTitle`.

outputPath.description: Path to save the screenshot (optional, defaults to temp directory)

windowTitle.description: Specific window title to screenshot (optional)

targetId.description: CDP target ID (from electron_list_windows). Takes precedence over windowTitle when both are provided. Required for unambiguous targeting when multiple Electron apps run on different debugging ports.

tools.name: read_electron_logs
tools.description: Read console logs and output from running Electron applications. Useful for debugging and monitoring app behavior.

lines.description: Number of recent lines to read (default: 100)

tools.name: electron_get_title
tools.description: Get the document.title of the focused Electron window. Read-only; safe in any security profile.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

tools.name: electron_get_url
tools.description: Get the window.location.href of the focused Electron window.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

tools.name: electron_get_body_text
tools.description: Get the first 500 chars of document.body.innerText (truncated for payload size).

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

tools.name: electron_find_elements
tools.description: Analyze all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selects, links) on the page with their properties, positions, and selectors. Returns JSON.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

tools.name: electron_get_page_structure
tools.description: Get an organized overview of page elements (buttons, inputs, selects, links) including detected framework. Returns JSON.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

tools.name: electron_debug_elements
tools.description: Get debugging info about top 10 visible buttons and form elements. Useful before clicking/filling.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

tools.name: electron_verify_form_state
tools.description: Inspect every <form> on the page: inputs, values, and HTML5 validity. Use after fill_input to confirm state.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

tools.name: electron_query_text_by_selector
tools.description: Read textContent of the first element matching the CSS selector. Returns "Element not found: <selector>" if no match.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element whose text content to read.

tools.name: electron_query_attribute_by_selector
tools.description: Read an HTML attribute (e.g., href, data-*, aria-*) via getAttribute. Returns "Element not found" or "Attribute not found" sentinels for missing cases.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to read the attribute from.

attributeName.description: Name of the HTML attribute to read (e.g., "href", "data-id", "aria-label").

tools.name: electron_query_value_by_selector
tools.description: Read the .value of an input, textarea, or select. Returns "Element not found" or "Element has no value property" sentinels for missing/non-form cases.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

selector.description: CSS selector for the input/textarea/select to read the value from.

tools.name: electron_query_visible_by_selector
tools.description: Check whether an element is visually rendered (non-zero size, display !== none, visibility !== hidden, opacity > 0). Returns "true"/"false" or "Element not found".

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to test for visibility.

tools.name: electron_query_enabled_by_selector
tools.description: Check whether a form control is enabled (returns "true"/"false"). Sentinels: "Element not found", "Element has no disabled property" for non-form elements.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

selector.description: CSS selector for the form control to test for enabled state.

tools.name: electron_click_by_selector
tools.description: Click an element by CSS selector. Returns the element tag/text on success. Note: same-selector clicks within ~1s are rate-limited and return "Click prevented - too soon after previous click" — serialize calls (await each) to avoid this. Replaces the deprecated click_button — pass selector="button" to keep that behavior.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to click (e.g., "button.submit", "#login")

tools.name: electron_click_by_text
tools.description: Click an element by visible text, aria-label, or title. Best for buttons/links. Returns confidence score on match. Note: same-element clicks within ~2s are rate-limited and return an error containing "Element click prevented - too soon after previous click" — serialize calls (await each) to avoid this.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

text.description: Visible text, aria-label, or title to match. Best-effort scoring; pass a longer/more unique substring when matches are ambiguous.

tools.name: electron_double_click_by_selector
tools.description: Double-click an element by CSS selector using CDP mouse events. Triggers handlers that synthetic dblclick misses (Monaco, canvas, etc.).

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to double-click.

tools.name: electron_right_click_by_selector
tools.description: Right-click an element by CSS selector using CDP mouse events. Triggers contextmenu and native context menu UI.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to right-click.

tools.name: electron_drag_from_to
tools.description: Drag from a source element to a target element using CDP mouse events. Includes intermediate moves so drag libraries (react-dnd, dnd-kit) recognize the gesture.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

fromSelector.description: CSS selector for the drag source element.

toSelector.description: CSS selector for the drop target element.

tools.name: electron_hover_by_selector
tools.description: Hover over element by CSS selector using CDP-level mouse events. Triggers tooltips/popovers that synthetic JS events miss (Radix UI, etc.).

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to hover over.

tools.name: electron_hover_by_text
tools.description: Hover over element by visible text using CDP-level mouse events. Triggers tooltips/popovers that synthetic JS events miss.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

text.description: Visible text substring (case-insensitive) of the element to hover over.

tools.name: electron_fill_input
tools.description: Fill an input or textarea with a value. React-aware (uses native setter so controlled components update). Identify by selector OR placeholder/label.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

value.description: Text to fill into the input. Required.

selector.description: CSS selector for the input. Pass either selector or placeholder.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text, label text, name, or aria-label to identify the input via fuzzy match.

tools.name: electron_select_option
tools.description: Select a dropdown option by value or visible text. Identify the <select> via selector or adjacent label text.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

value.description: Option value or option text content to select. Required.

selector.description: CSS selector for the <select> element. Pass either selector or text.

text.description: Label text adjacent to the <select> to identify it (used when selector is omitted).

tools.name: electron_navigate_to_hash
tools.description: Navigate to a hash route (e.g., "#create"). Uses pushState + manual hashchange + popstate dispatch so both legacy listeners and react-router-dom v7 HashRouter pick it up.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

hash.description: Hash route to navigate to (e.g., "#create" or "create"). Leading "#" is optional.

tools.name: electron_wait_for_selector
tools.description: Wait for a CSS selector to match. MutationObserver-based; returns "Found" or "Timeout" within timeoutMs (default 5000ms).

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds (default 5000, capped at 60000).

tools.name: electron_wait_for_text
tools.description: Wait until a substring appears in document.body. MutationObserver-based; returns "Found" or "Timeout" within timeoutMs (default 5000ms).

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

text.description: Substring to wait for in document.body.textContent.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds (default 5000, capped at 60000).

tools.name: electron_wait_for_navigation
tools.description: Wait for a URL change (or for the URL to contain expectedUrlSubstring). Default 10000ms, capped at 120000ms.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

expectedUrlSubstring.description: If provided, wait until window.location.href contains this substring. Otherwise, wait for any URL change.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds (default 10000, capped at 120000).

tools.name: electron_wait_for_function
tools.description: Poll a JS expression until it returns truthy. operationType=eval (validated). Default 5000ms, polled every 100ms.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

code.description: JavaScript expression to poll. Should return a truthy value when the wait condition is met.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds (default 5000, capped at 60000).

tools.name: electron_wait_for_load_state
tools.description: Wait for page lifecycle: load | domcontentloaded | networkidle. Default 30000ms, networkidle = 500ms quiet window.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

state.description: Page lifecycle state to wait for. "load" = window.load fired, "domcontentloaded" = DOMContentLoaded fired, "networkidle" = no fetch/XHR for 500ms.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds (default 30000, capped at 120000).

tools.name: electron_scroll_to_element
tools.description: Scroll an element into view via scrollIntoView. Defaults to block:center so sticky headers do not obscure it.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to scroll into view.

block.description: Vertical alignment of the element after scrolling.

tools.name: electron_scroll_by_pixels
tools.description: Scroll the window by a pixel delta. Returns the new (scrollX, scrollY) so callers can verify movement.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

deltaX.description: Horizontal pixels to scroll. Positive = right.

deltaY.description: Vertical pixels to scroll. Positive = down.

tools.name: electron_get_viewport_size
tools.description: Read viewport innerWidth/innerHeight and devicePixelRatio. Returns JSON {width, height, devicePixelRatio}.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

tools.name: electron_get_scroll_position
tools.description: Read scroll metrics for the window (default) or an element matching `selector`. Returns JSON {scrollX, scrollY, maxScrollX, maxScrollY}; element variants source the values from el.scrollLeft / scrollTop / scrollWidth - clientWidth / scrollHeight - clientHeight.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector. When provided, returns scroll metrics for that element (overflow:auto / overflow:scroll viewport). Omit to read window scroll.

tools.name: electron_send_keyboard_shortcut
tools.description: Dispatch a keyboard shortcut (e.g., "Ctrl+N", "Enter") on document. Best for app-level hotkeys, not input typing.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

shortcut.description: Shortcut to send (e.g., "Ctrl+N", "Meta+S", "Enter", "Escape", "ArrowDown"). Modifiers: Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Meta/Cmd.

tools.name: electron_press_key
tools.description: Press a single key with optional modifiers via CDP. Use this for real keyboard input (cursor moves, IME) — for app hotkeys prefer electron_send_keyboard_shortcut. Note: macOS OS-level shortcuts (Cmd+A, Cmd+C/V/X, Cmd+Z) are bypassed by CDP synthetic events; use electron_eval (.select() / navigator.clipboard.*) instead.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

key.description: Key to press (e.g., "a", "Enter", "ArrowDown", "Backspace"). Single chars or special key names.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the press.

tools.name: electron_local_storage_get_item
tools.description: Read a single key from localStorage. Returns the raw string or "Item not found: <key>". Returns "Storage unavailable" when the renderer blocks access.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

tools.name: electron_local_storage_set_item
tools.description: Write a single key/value to localStorage. Value is stored verbatim; pre-serialize objects with JSON.stringify.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

value.description: Value to store. localStorage stores strings only; pre-serialize objects with JSON.stringify.

tools.name: electron_session_storage_get_item
tools.description: Read a single key from sessionStorage. Returns the raw string or "Item not found: <key>".

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

tools.name: electron_session_storage_set_item
tools.description: Write a single key/value to sessionStorage. Value is stored verbatim; cleared on window close (unlike localStorage).

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

value.description: Value to store. sessionStorage stores strings only; pre-serialize objects with JSON.stringify.

tools.name: electron_clear_storage
tools.description: Clear local/session/cookie storage scopes. Cookies are best-effort (HttpOnly survives) — for full wipe use session.clearStorageData in main process.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

scopes.description: Storage scopes to clear. Cookies are cleared for the current document.cookie origin only. Accepts a JSON-encoded array string for clients that serialize arrays as strings.

tools.name: electron_eval
tools.description: Execute custom JavaScript with structured error reporting. Last resort — use specific tools (click, fill, query) when possible.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

code.description: JavaScript code to execute in the Electron renderer. Last-resort escape hatch — prefer specific commands when possible.

tools.name: electron_console_log
tools.description: Emit a message via console.log in the renderer. Useful for test sanity checks.

targetId.description: CDP target ID for exact-match window targeting. Use list_electron_windows to discover IDs.

windowTitle.description: Window title for case-insensitive partial-match targeting. Ignored if targetId is set.

message.description: Message to log via console.log in the renderer.
